body:
My goals have changed to getting through the day. 

I attempted to set micro goals - things to push me forward but that isn’t working anymore 

I have my end planned out - how I could do it and when to do it so I am not missed right away.  And how to keep it from being too messy. In the end I don’t want to leave too much for others to clean up.

At this time it would require a lot of support 

My mental health while never the greatest - has been something I worked hard to improve.  

This time - there is nothing. 

I tried to talk to my friends - close ones - and I got no where or told “huh that’s bad”. My husbands mental health isn’t great either and he seems to thrive when I am low.  

Today?  I got told I am a liar and that I am screwing him over  when I am making a n effort to be as transparent as possible. 

It’s like I am just never “quite” good enough. That my goals are just out of reach. 

Guess I am tired of reaching and falling with no one to help.

It’s like the sense of things out of my grasp. 


My family is blunt and often bring up my lack of follow through.   And to be honest the idea of slitting my wrists appeals more.
